title: RimWorld actor corpus efficacy ladder
purpose: Test the shared GlueActors component tree in RimWorld while keeping declarative selection, native legality, execution, and receipt evidence distinct.

evidenceClasses.declared: JSON parses, shared references resolve, and the tenant is registered as an editor-visible datasource.
evidenceClasses.engine: The shared Glue template returns a structured result and verified workflow receipt.
evidenceClasses.native: RimWorld observes native facts, admits or rejects a candidate through its own JobGiver/WorkGiver boundary, and emits a read-back receipt.
evidenceClasses.lifecycle: The mount persists and reads back across save/load and host outage/reconnect while preserving semantic identity.
evidenceClasses.efficacy: Repeated fixtures produce the intended native state transition, rejection behavior, and reconciliation outcome; one successful receipt is not sufficient.

currentEvidence.evidence: GlueRimworld/manifest.json registers the tenant manifest and the shared actor-domain manifest reference resolves from the seed location.
RimworldSeedCatalog currently loads the local need, schedule, skill, and candidate seeds directly; it does not parse the tenant manifest or shared domain manifest.
work/deterministic-native-quicktest.log and work/live-reconnect-quicktest.log record eat-meal selection with receiptVerified=True.
work/deterministic-native-quicktest.log records native JobGiver status=admitted:eat-meal and verified native receipts for two pawns.
The candidate pack declares eat-meal, rest-in-bed, haul-designated, and construct-designated, but the retained native logs only show admitted eat-meal.
The native and reconnect logs record persisted/read-back mount heartbeats; the reconnect log records bounded failures followed by successful hour-9 remount activity.
The current Player.log quicktest command contains vanilla DLC initialization but no GlueRimworld load marker; it must not be counted as a Glue actor test.
work/mod-enabled-quicktest-2.log contains shader errors and repeated post-long-event NullReferenceException noise; it is unsuitable as a clean efficacy run.

passPolicy.unsupportedCandidates: remain declared and fail closed until native admission and readback are observed
minimumPublishableCoverage: all universal domains have an observation receipt
at least one positive and one typed rejection per native boundary
fresh clean run with zero targeted bridge errors
